baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct-object construction joins first-person causative destruction to wealth qualified as a piled mass.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker presents himself as the agent who made a concentrated stock of property perish. The heap image makes quantity spatial and material, while the destruction verb is stronger than neutral transfer or expenditure.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the line an overt self-report whose wording is itself part of the event.
Ruin and extinction give the causative verb the force of making resources disappear, not merely moving them.
Acquired property supplies the stock over which the speaker claims destructive agency.
Gathered abundance piled upon itself turns the amount into a visible concentrated heap.

changed_reading.before: He says that he spent a great deal of money.
changed_reading.after: He openly claims to have made a piled concentration of owned resources perish; destructive agency and heap structure remain audible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The present-tense saying introduces a first-person claim whose only stated warrant is the magnitude of the alleged loss.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance can operate as circulating self-display and as an attempted verdict on the speaker's own standing. A false or inflated report remains live without being presumed: saying that a heap was destroyed tries to make the asserted cost authorize the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk lets the first-person statement function as reputation-making rather than private bookkeeping.
Arrogating judgment supplies the social move by which the speaker tries to pronounce his own expenditure sufficient.
False saying keeps exaggeration or misattribution available as a risk of the boast, not as a settled accusation.
Claimed ruin provides the costly deed that the utterance converts into social credit.
The heaped amount supplies impressive scale for the attempted self-authorization.

changed_reading.before: The sentence records a completed expenditure.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is also a public performance: the speaker offers the scale of an alleged loss as its own proof and verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative destruction verb can resonate with exhausting effort and futility while its object remains the speaker's amassed resources.
baseline_models.mechanism: The claim can be heard as a self-assessment of resources worn out through strenuous, possibly pointless effort. This reading does not erase the boast; it preserves a coexisting plea that the speaker has been depleted by what he undertook.

activation_trace.role: Saying with the force of supposing lets the utterance carry the speaker's own assessment of what his effort amounted to.
Exhausting effort shifts destruction toward resources consumed by toil.
The valley of futility keeps open the possibility that the costly effort produced no worthy result.
Wealth supplies the finite reserve depleted by the exertion.
The accumulated heap magnifies both the claimed effort and the possible waste.

changed_reading.before: He boasts that he disposed of abundant wealth.
changed_reading.after: He may also be pleading that a whole reserve was exhausted in strenuous, perhaps futile, effort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective on wealth evokes compacted layers and staying stuck, while the verb attacks the resulting mass.
baseline_models.mechanism: Quantity becomes material topology: wealth is not only numerous but felted, layered, and immobilized. Destroying it can therefore be imagined as breaking down a compact stock, with the ethical value of that decompaction still wholly undecided at baseline.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth provides the material stock being compacted.
Layer-over-layer compaction gives the wealth pile a dense material structure.
Sticking in place adds immobilization to the image of accumulated resources.
Destruction supplies the force that dismantles or eliminates the compact stock.

changed_reading.before: A large numerical amount was spent.
changed_reading.after: A dense, immobilized stock was broken down; whether that is waste, release, or conversion remains open.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human hardship activates the exhausting-effort branch of the focus verb. The same sentence can therefore sound less like carefree largesse and more like a speaker pleading that accumulated resources were consumed under strain.

activation_trace.role: The overt report is the form in which the speaker voices his account of depletion.
Exhausting effort allows the claimed destruction to be heard as depletion through toil.
The heap marks the scale of the reserve allegedly exhausted.
Hardship supplies the surrounding condition that can turn a boast of loss into a plea of burden.

structural_cues: 90:4 places the human in hardship immediately before the questions and the focus claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship and exhausting effort; I infer that the speaker may present expenditure as evidence of having borne that hardship. The live alternative is still ostentatious boasting.

changed_reading.after: I exhausted a whole reserve under severe effort, a plea that can coexist with the boast.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oath, counting, measure, and contested capacity place the self-report inside an external audit. The speaker's quantity claim no longer proves either the event or his power; it becomes an entry to be measured against a standard he does not control.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech identifies the claim that enters the audit.
The false-saying branch keeps accuracy open as a question rather than allowing the amount to authenticate itself.
The heaped amount is the magnitude the speaker submits as evidence.
An oath distributed to its parties supplies a higher frame of attestation around the man's mere assertion.
Counting and accounting turn the vague boast of abundance into something answerable to reckoning.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the external scale against which the claimed heap is tested.
Effective power separates possessing means from actually controlling the judgment or outcome.

structural_cues: The focus claim is bracketed by repeated rhetorical questions about what the man supposes no one can do or see.
The surah opens with an oath, while the man's sentence is only reported speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, account, measure, and power; I infer an adjudicative relation in which the speaker's number is evidence rather than verdict. He may still be truthful about the expenditure while mistaken about what it establishes.

changed_reading.before: The large expenditure demonstrates the speaker's power and standing.
changed_reading.after: The expenditure is an unverified self-entry in a larger reckoning; neither its amount nor its meaning is self-certified.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation, creation, feeding another, and a child cut off from a caregiver establish a life-producing counterflow to annihilation. The missing beneficiary of the focus claim becomes diagnostic: costly loss is not yet life-giving expenditure.

activation_trace.role: Extinction supplies the focus action whose outcome is tested against generation and sustenance.
Owned resources provide the convertible input.
Concentrated abundance makes the absence of any named recipient especially conspicuous.
Something generated from something else supplies a productive transformation opposed to bare disappearance.
Bringing creation into being sharpens the contrast between generative use and annihilated stock.
Feeding another gives wealth a concrete path into sustaining a body.
A child cut off from a caregiver supplies the vulnerable life toward which converted wealth could be directed.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from parent and offspring and human creation to a claim of destroyed wealth, then later specifies feeding and an orphan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, creation, nourishment, and severed care; I infer that expenditure is evaluated by whether destruction becomes sustenance. The focus grammar does not name a beneficiary, so genuine charitable spending remains possible but unstated.

changed_reading.before: The greatness of the expenditure lies in how much wealth vanished.
changed_reading.after: The claim is ethically underdescribed: loss becomes meaningful only if the heap is converted into generated or sustained life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim is produced by a tongue between lips and exposed to sight and watchfulness. Speech is therefore neither disembodied nor private: the very capacities that enable the boast also make it observable and answerable.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech is the bodily act placed under observation.
Possible false saying states what embodied witnessing can expose without predetermining guilt.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the witnessing that contests presumed invisibility.
The eye of watchful care adds sustained oversight rather than a momentary glance.
The tongue supplies the instrument that turns an inner claim into accountable sound.
Speech passing from lip to lip makes circulation and reception part of the claim's social life.

structural_cues: The repeated question about whether anyone saw is followed by eyes, tongue, and lips.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing and the organs of speaking; I infer an evidence relation in which endowed speech is exposed to endowed perception. The witness need not be a human audience alone.

changed_reading.before: The speaker controls the story of his expenditure.
changed_reading.after: His claim is an embodied testimony issued through visible gifts and already open to observation, circulation, and contradiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Direction, elevation, reckless entry into hardship, and the difficult rise separate expense from achievement. A heap can be exhausted through undirected plunging; only a directed crossing makes the cost part of ascent.

activation_trace.role: Exhausting effort supplies costly motion that may or may not reach a worthy destination.
The immense heap measures cost but does not by itself prove passage.
Gentle direction toward a road or truth supplies the orientation missing from bare expenditure.
Elevation turns the path into an ascent with a real change of level.
Plunging into hardship without deliberation supplies a costly but potentially misdirected alternative.
The difficult rising obstacle supplies the threshold that expenditure alone does not cross.

structural_cues: The claim of destroyed wealth precedes guidance to two heights and the statement that the speaker did not storm the ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, height, reckless entry, and a hard rise; I infer that costly action is being distinguished from successful traversal. An alternative remains that the claimed spending was one genuine but incomplete attempt.

changed_reading.before: A sufficiently costly deed proves moral accomplishment.
changed_reading.after: The fortune may have been exhausted in motion that never crossed the decisive rise; cost is not equivalent to ascent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening what is locked and releasing a pledged neck provide a constructive direction for destroying a heap. The focus can now be read as liquidation or decompaction: accumulated property is broken apart so that a bound life is unfastened.

activation_trace.role: Causative destruction supplies the dismantling force, whose value now depends on what it releases.
Possessed wealth is the capital stock available for liquidation.
Layered compaction gives the stock the structure that must be broken open.
Opening a closure and separating an entanglement converts destruction into purposeful decompaction.
Releasing collateral or a neck gives the opened wealth a concrete liberating outcome.
Capital or the pure core of property forms a lexical bridge between the wealth heap and what can purchase release.
The neck supplies the bound person whose freedom distinguishes release from waste.

structural_cues: The first explicit explanation of the ascent is the compact nominal construction about unfastening a neck.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a compact heap, opening, collateral, capital, and a neck; I infer a flow from dismantled stock to released person. The alternative is ordinary waste, because the focus itself names no release.

changed_reading.before: The heap is valuable because its disappearance was costly.
changed_reading.after: The heap can be worth destroying when its compaction is liquidated into the unfastening of a bound life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes two forms of gathering: things piled together and people joined through kinship, reciprocal counsel, mercy, and companionship. Wealth ceases to be a socially inert mass when its decompaction repairs isolation and builds relation.

activation_trace.role: Piled abundance supplies a dense gathering of things that can be contrasted with a gathering of persons.
Isolation and loss of a peer expose the social deficit that a mere property heap cannot answer.
Kinship and lineage direct redistributed wealth toward an already binding relation.
Joining one thing to another supplies the connective mechanics of community.
Reciprocal counsel makes relation mutual rather than a donor's solitary performance.
Womb-kinship joins mercy to a generative bond instead of an abstract sentiment.
Companionship supplies the resulting social assembly that can replace an assembly of wealth.

structural_cues: The first-person singular boast is followed by reciprocal verbs and plural companion-groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies isolated person, kinship, joining, reciprocity, mercy, and companionship; I infer that dispersed wealth can reassemble as social bonds. The alternative is that these relations evaluate conduct without redefining the focus heap itself.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's achievement is the magnitude of property he personally consumed.
changed_reading.after: A pile of things is judged by whether its breakup produces a joined company of people rather than a larger solitary reputation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wealth pile and the destitute person share immobilization: one sticks in accumulated place, the other is stilled and pressed to dust. Purposeful expenditure becomes a transfer that unsticks both sides rather than a theatrical disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Owned wealth supplies the immobilized resource side of the relation.
Staying put and sticking to the ground make the accumulated stock materially immobile.
Loss of movement supplies the human immobility mirrored by stuck wealth.
Humbling destitution gives that immobility its social force.
Poverty figured as sticking to dust completes the spatial analogy with the grounded heap.

structural_cues: 90:16 places the destitute person in a condition named by earth immediately after the feeding alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two independent images of sticking and stillness; I infer a transfer that reverses both immobilizations. The analogy is material and social, not a claim that the two words are synonyms.

changed_reading.before: Destroying wealth means making a possession disappear.
changed_reading.after: Worthy destruction unsticks concentrated resources and a person stuck in destitution by setting support in motion between them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A thing can 'say' by indicating, while a sign and a visible beacon make consequences legible. The focus now contains rival speakers: the man's mouth reports destruction, but the remaining material and social traces can state what the wealth actually became.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as indication lets outcomes speak alongside the man's verbal report.
Claimed disappearance creates the evidentiary question of what effects, residues, or beneficiaries remain.
Layered material gives the alleged expenditure a substrate capable of leaving observable traces.
A manifest sign supplies nonverbal evidence against which the self-report can be read.
A visible beacon supplies the image of consequences made conspicuous rather than hidden in speech.

structural_cues: The surah moves from the man's saying and the question of being seen to signs and a final visible outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies indication, manifest sign, and visible marker; I infer that effects can function as testimony. The alternative is to keep 'he says' strictly verbal and treat the later signs as a separate register.

changed_reading.before: Only the speaker's sentence tells us that the wealth was destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The wealth's material and social aftermath becomes a rival utterance: its traces say whether the heap became release, nourishment, waste, or concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering and doubled images of tight closure reactivate false saying and stuck compaction. The claim that wealth is gone may conceal retained value, status consumption, or a sealed destructive outcome; alternatively, the wealth truly became fuel but produced enclosure rather than release.

activation_trace.role: False saying supplies the possible cover-story mechanism without deciding that the speaker lied.
Sticking in place keeps open the possibility that value remained immobilized despite the claim of destruction.
Covering supplies the act by which a declaration of loss could hide what the expenditure actually produced.
Kindled fire supplies the alternative in which wealth really is consumed but only as destructive fuel.
Closing tightly over something supplies enclosure as the opposite outcome to opening and release.
The non-dominant mapped branch independently reinforces a door sealed with deliberate firmness.

structural_cues: The sequence names opening and release at 90:13 but ends with something closed tightly over its occupants at 90:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, fire, stuckness, and closure; I infer either concealed retention or consumption that culminates in enclosure. A live alternative is straightforward truthful spending with no concealment at all.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's wealth is simply gone.
changed_reading.after: The declaration of disappearance may cover an immobilized conversion, or name a real burn whose sealed outcome is the reverse of liberating outflow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل target mapped from the focus speech root. It remains anchored by the explicit contrast between heaped abundance and the branch of fewness, but downstream prose should present it only as a split-root activation, not as the surface meaning of يَقُولُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The utterance places a claim of making an abundant property heap disappear beside a mapped branch of fewness and poverty.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped branch of fewness supplies the endpoint latent inside the act of claiming depletion.
Destruction supplies the transition that can reduce the stock.
Wealth supplies what moves from possession toward paucity.
Heaped abundance supplies the starting pole of the reversal.

changed_reading.before: The speaker magnifies himself by naming abundance.
changed_reading.after: The same sentence can faintly undercut him as an admission that he converted abundance into littleness or impoverishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy triggered by the packet's conditional spider term for م و ل, not an etymology of مال. It remains anchored through the focus wealth, compaction, sticking, and destruction branches; render it only as a speculative image of entanglement and attempted disentanglement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wealth noun carries a remote spider-term branch while its adjective depicts a layered mass stuck in place.

activation_trace.role: The reported spider term supplies the remote image of an entangling structure.
Layered compaction gives the speculative web a dense accumulated body.
Sticking in place supplies the entanglement's immobilizing effect.
Destruction can then be imagined as either tearing the web apart or being ruined inside it.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a passive quantity the speaker consumed.
changed_reading.after: Wealth becomes an entangling, compact structure: the claim may describe tearing free of it or perishing within it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The camel waste-clump branch is materially vivid and deliberately abrasive. It remains anchored in the focus adjective and the futility branch of the destruction verb, but downstream prose should mark it as devaluing analogy rather than a lexical gloss for لُّبَدًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The boast's magnificent heap can be reversed by a focus branch in which a felt-like clump is bodily waste.

activation_trace.role: The clump of dung and urine degrades the prestigious heap into an accumulated residue.
Futility turns costly consumption into a result without durable value.
Actual property supplies the high-value input whose residue is being satirically revalued.
Public talk supplies the boast that the degrading material image reverses.

changed_reading.before: The heaped amount magnifies the expenditure and its speaker.
changed_reading.after: The heap can be abrasively revalued as compacted waste, making the boast an inadvertent confession of futile consumption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation crosses from the contextual making and eye roots into their reward and ready-cash branches. It remains anchored to the focus wealth and destruction construction, but should be rendered as a speculative ledger reading, not as the direct sense of eyes or making in 90:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The generic wealth object can be narrowed into a claimed pile of liquid payouts when contextual branches activate reward and cash on hand.

activation_trace.role: Destruction supplies the depletion of the proposed liquid fund.
Wealth supplies the broad asset category narrowed by the contextual branches.
A reward assigned for work supplies a possible payout category for the alleged expenditure.
Ready cash supplies liquidity rather than an undifferentiated property heap.

changed_reading.before: The speaker claims the loss of wealth in general.
changed_reading.after: A remote ledger reading hears a claim of burning through a piled fund of cash assigned as payments or rewards.

strongest_changes: The self-reported heap becomes evidence inside an external accounting rather than a self-authenticating proof of power.
Destruction is tested by conversion: wealth may be wasted, or productively decompacted into release, feeding, and sustained life.
The compact, stuck heap acquires a social topology opposite the isolated orphan and dust-stuck destitute person; redistribution can turn immobilized things into relation.
Speech no longer monopolizes testimony, because eyes, signs, and material consequences can disclose what the wealth actually became.
Cost is separated from ascent: exhausting a fortune may be undirected plunging rather than successful passage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting motions instead of one verdict: boast and hardship plea, annihilation and liberating liquidation, public self-authorization and external witness, material compaction and social reassembly. Split-root and remote material branches also produced contained reversals that a conservative reading would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not decide whether أَهْلَكْتُ is neutral spending, boastful waste, exhaustive toil, or productive liquidation.
The statement may be truthful, inflated, or self-authorizing; the context makes it auditable but does not syntactically resolve its truth value.
No beneficiary is named in 90:6, so later release and feeding can evaluate or redirect the claim without proving that they were its original objects.
The paucity, spider, waste-clump, and cash-reward readings are packet-backed activations but remain cross-domain or mapping-distant and require explicit qualification.
